rationalization.consequence: The canal overtops toward Amsterdam — the near-miss level
rationalization.required_action: Close the discharge gates and verify the protection layer's state

rationalization.consequence: The gate answers the field, not the control layer — the incident's root annunciation
rationalization.required_action: Confirm local control at the gate and verify the commanded position

rationalization.consequence: The gate is demanded safe but confirmed open — water keeps coming in
rationalization.required_action: Verify the gate's local control and the protection layer's action

rationalization.consequence: The canal level is diverging from its trend — rising or falling fast
rationalization.required_action: Check the level trend and the gate positions

rationalization.consequence: The remote repeater carries the level path — degraded or stale data may be serving
rationalization.required_action: Check the primary level instrument and the remote link

rationalization.consequence: The independent high-high layer has tripped — the canal is beyond the DCS's protection
rationalization.required_action: Confirm the layer's action and the gate state; do not credit the alarm path

rationalization.consequence: The protection layer is bypassed — its independent action is unavailable
rationalization.required_action: Restore the bypass and re-verify the layer

rationalization.consequence: The protection layer reports a fault — its availability is in question
